tokenization.unit: one serialized input_text at a time in corpus JSONL order; no batch, added prompt, truncation, or padding
tokenization.offset_unit: character offsets; corpus inputs are ASCII so offsets equal UTF-8 byte offsets
tokenization.sequence_positions: Every returned input ID occupies one model-visible position. First position is 0; final position is sequence_length-1. Record both positions and token IDs. Special positions remain model-visible for these positions and V0, but are excluded from span means.

span_alignment.span_occurrences: Resolve every recorded half-open character span separately. A nonspecial token is selected only when its nonempty offset overlaps the span; every selected token offset must lie wholly inside that span.
span_alignment.coverage: Every character in each span must be covered by exactly one selected nonspecial token; a gap, overlap, boundary-crossing token, empty position set, or invalid offset affecting a required span is ambiguous and rejects that input.
span_alignment.union: After every occurrence independently passes, report occurrence-level token positions and the sorted deduplicated union of positions for each span type.
span_alignment.rejection: Keep every input in the alignment JSONL and list every rejection reason. Do not repair, omit, or relabel any input. Any ambiguous required span makes S01_2_TOKEN_ALIGNMENT_READY false.

token_identity.token_ids_sha256: SHA-256 of token IDs serialized as consecutive little-endian unsigned 32-bit integers, with no header or separators
token_identity.offset_mapping: Store the complete ordered list of [start,end] integer pairs, including all special-token positions.
token_identity.special_tokens_mask: Store the complete ordered binary mask returned by the pinned fast tokenizer.

determinism.sample_selection: The first 256 variant rows in sealed corpus JSONL order, selected without tokenizer outputs.
determinism.repeat: After exhaustive tokenization, tokenize those 256 same input strings again, one at a time, with the same frozen options. Compare canonical serialized token IDs, token-ID hash, offsets, special mask, sequence length, first/final positions, span mappings, and rejection reasons exactly. Any mismatch fails closed.

support_gates.support_unit: complete A/C/E/P quartet; a quartet is complete only if all four inputs pass context, entity, and relation alignment
support_gates.on_shortage: FAIL_CLOSED; report every under-supported cell and do not merge cells or lower support

outputs: tokenizer asset manifest with exact commit and SHA-256 for every allowed file
one alignment JSONL record for every sealed event
repeat-check receipt for the fixed 256-event sample
forbidden: LFM model weights or model instantiation
hidden states, feature extraction, feature cache, or backbone writes
corpus mutation or individual string repair
span-definition, tokenizer, representation-view, threshold, or support-rule changes
probe fitting, representation geometry, evaluation, or S01-3 authorization

required_terminal_gates.S01_2_TOKEN_ALIGNMENT_READY: PASS only if tokenizer identity matches, all 106496 rows are tokenized, all required spans are unambiguous, repeat check matches, and every support cell remains at 16
